primary_endpoint: Safety and tolerability events through study day 42, plus CRV431 Tmax, Cmax, and AUC0-last on days 1 and 28.
safety_signal: Treatment-emergent AE counts were reported by dose group, but the listed counts are not labeled by event category. No serious AEs or deaths: 0/15 (CRV431 75 mg), 0/17 (CRV431 225 mg), 0/6 (placebo 75 mg), and 0/9 (placebo 225 mg).
